## Exam 01 {.midi}

-   In-class, 75 minutes
-   Non-programmable calculator permitted; one sheet of handwritten notes.
-   No other aids (notes, textbooks, computers, phones)
-   Show work when requested; clearly label answers

## Content: Weeks 1–5

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   Exploratory data analysis (EDA)
-   Fitting and interpreting simple linear regression (SLR)
-   Regression equations and interpretation (slope/intercept)
-   Simulation-based inference (randomization test for slope)
-   Mathematical models for inference (t-based CIs/tests)
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
-   Prediction vs. confidence intervals
-   Model conditions and residual diagnostics
-   Model evaluation and assumptions in context
:::
:::

## Format {.midi}

-   Four sections
    -   Multiple choice (concepts, interpretation)
    -   Short answer (concise reasoning, set up calculations)
    -   True/False with justification (1–2 sentences)
    -   Evaluate a response (diagnose a student’s statement)
-   Emphasis on interpretation and understanding
-   You will not write code; you may be asked to interpret provided output
